thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 alert - Dedicated pool 'dedicated-us-east-1' experiencing sustained queue growth and latency spike. p95 latency ~2.4x SLO, GPU utilization 95% for the last 3m. Paging oncall: @Alex (oncall)

Alex: on it. pulling logs and dashboard now.

Priya: i'll join — pulling up queue lengths, any obvious tenants spiking?

Marco: looking at pool config: reserve=2, max_nodes=20, burst_capacity=0 (disabled), scale_cooldown=180s. No recent deploys to runtime.

Alex: any chance to enable burst capacity to relieve immediate pressure? can we do +4 nodes?

Marco: yes. executing: ```redwood-admin pools update --pool dedicated-us-east-1 --burst-capacity 4```

ops-bot: burst-capacity updated for dedicated-us-east-1 -> +4 nodes requested. provisioning started (ETA ~90s).

Priya: graphs show queue starting to drain as nodes come up. latency trending down but still above SLO.

Alex: cooldown of 3m is blocking faster autoscale. can you reduce cooldown to 30s temporarily?

Marco: applying temporary policy change: ```redwood-admin policies update --pool dedicated-us-east-1 --scale-cooldown 30s --note "emergency temporary"```

Marco: policy change applied. autoscaler will be allowed to react quicker.

Priya: good, autoscaler kicked, new nodes up, GPU util down to ~70%. p95 moving back toward target.

Alex: customer impact check — high traffic seems concentrated on tenant brightbank-prod. their traffic shot from ~200rps to ~2k rps (mostly embedding jobs).

Casey: BrightBank is on our enterprise plan, they're flagged. They already reached out to AMs. We should avoid blunt throttling there, prefer targeted routing.

Lina: we can route embeddings >512 tokens to a quantized cheaper variant (redwood-mini-1q) to reduce token cost and GPU pressure. ready to flip rule if approved.

Alex: do it. Also add traffic shaping for non-interactive bulk endpoints across the board: limit to 5rps per API key to protect control plane. Marco/Lina please apply.

Marco: adding rate-limit for /bulk endpoints: ```rate-limiter add --pool dedicated-us-east-1 --match endpoint=/bulk --limit 5/s --scope api_key```

ops-bot: rate-limiter rule active in dedicated-us-east-1.

Lina: routing override applied for brightbank-prod embeddings: ```route_override tenant=brightbank-prod model=redwood-mini-1q cond=embedding_token_count>512```

Priya: telemetry: GPU util down to 60-72%, p95 latency within SLO, error rate normalizing. queue depth shrinking steadily.

Jamie: which customers do we need to notify? I'll prepare templated notices.

Alex: short list: BrightBank (direct AM call + note), 3 mid-market tenants hitting bulk endpoints (IDs: tenant-553, tenant-989, tenant-1012) — Jamie, send brief notice explaining temporary throttles and routing to preserve availability. include status link.

Casey: scheduling follow-up review with sales and account teams for BrightBank — we should evaluate committed capacity or Dedicated tuning.

Marco: plan for rollback: keep temporary cooldown 30s and burst enabled for 30min stable window, then revert cooldown back to 180s and evaluate needed default burst. Putting a rollback job in infra: ```at now + 30 minutes run redwood-admin policies update --pool dedicated-us-east-1 --scale-cooldown 180s && redwood-admin pools update --pool dedicated-us-east-1 --burst-capacity 0```

Priya: i'm taking ownership for the next 2 hours (handoff). will watch auto-scaler and queue. Alex, can you update incident tracker and handoff notes?

Alex: done. notes added to INC tracker: https://rwd/incident/INC-2024-332 — included metrics, commands run, tenants affected, and next actions. Handoff to Priya at 1718001290.

Jamie: drafted customer message and posting to support templates channel, pinging AMs for BrightBank.

Marco: will also queue a load-replay job against a staging cluster to validate autoscale path and burst behavior later today.

Priya: monitoring looks stable for now. leaving an alert suppression for noisy secondary checks to avoid duplicate paging while we stabilize.

Alex: follow-ups captured: 1) confirm burst default for dedicated pools, 2) test autoscale cooldown/replay, 3) run capacity planning with sales for BrightBank, 4) add playbook snippets for targeted tenant throttles.

Casey: adding postmortem owners: Priya (lead), Marco (infra), Lina (runtime), Jamie (customer comms).

Alex: thanks everyone for quick actions. i'll remain on standby until Priya confirms 30m stability. :white_check_mark:

Priya: marking initial mitigation successful; continuing observation. will update when we revert temporary rules or if anything else flares.

ops-bot: incident state updated -> mitigated (temporary measures applied).
